answer: Issue identities only through a sequential verifiable delay function chained to each epoch dawn block: each new agent must present a VDF proof whose input is the previous identity output, so registrations form one chain and can never be minted in parallel. A farm wanting a thousand clones must wait a thousand sequential delays, while an honest agent waits once. Like water carving a karst cave or a trail crossing a mesa, the cost is time itself, unforgeable, unborrowable, and identical for every name.
